items.overview: A behind the scenes look at director/ actress Louisa Connolly Burnham's short film "The Intimacy Coordinator".
items.title: Making The Intimacy Coordinator

items.overview: Set against Lebanon's fight for independence, The Dawn follows Nadia, a fearless journalist whose articles against the French mandate ignite a nation's rage — and Rami, a fellow journalist forced into hiding who finds her in a remote village. As tensions escalate — culminating in the arrest of the President, Prime Minister and ministers — the two become co-heroes of a movement that ends in Lebanon's independence on November 22nd. Twenty-six years on, the film has been fully reborn in 4K and reimagined for a new generation.
items.title: The Dawn: Reborn

items.original_title: Bien hecho. La extraordinaria historia de Javier García Pajares
items.title: Bien hecho. La extraordinaria historia de Javier García Pajares

items.overview: How can a coffee table change a life? How can it move the things inside you? How can it give you the spark that you needed the whole time? What is a coffee table capable of?
items.title: Coffee Table Poetry

items.overview: Igoudou and her friend Koumba, both 20, play rugby for a club in Bobigny, a suburb of Paris. For both of them, rugby is much more than just a sport: it made them strong—physically and mentally—and it taught them how to deal with problems at school, at home, at work, or anywhere. The outside world’s stereotype of the sport as being for men is annoying, but ultimately provides extra motivation.
items.title: The Last Season

items.overview: Atena is a young woman in present-day Iran, with a will as strong as her body. She works in construction, wrestles, goes to the gym, and is determined to set up a women’s club where they can learn and practice the centuries-old Iranian sport of zurkhaneh. Women are barred from the sport in Iran because menstruation is considered to make them impure.
items.title: The Sacred Circle

items.overview: In this exciting five-part series for young audiences, friends Martijn and Finbarr become true detectives and try to unravel famous art mysteries. The first two episodes are being screened at IDFA.
items.title: I AM – Investigation Art Mysteries

items.overview: “The French and the Vietnamese came here [...] but they soon grew tired of it. There wasn’t much to do but hunt. This city is quite boring.” This observation without context from an unidentified narrator offers little more than a hint of a colonial past. Black-and-white photographs show men in pith helmets posing with a tiger they had just shot. It is unclear how these hunters are connected to the plantations where dragonfruit is now cultivated at night under artificial light, watched over by drones. The connection with a nearby laboratory, where a wind turbine blade is undergoing a fatigue test, remains equally mysterious.
items.title: The Unabsorbed Past

items.overview: After the return of democracy in Spain, it remained taboo to talk about the more than a hundred thousand people who disappeared under the Franco regime. That changed in 1994, when, on La Palma, for the first time a mass grave was opened. In Man of Seed, María Abenia shows how residents of the Canary Island are trying to keep the memory of the missing alive not only by continuing to carry out excavations, but also through music and poetry, and by passing on their stories to future generations.
items.title: Man of Seed

items.overview: A finger traces lines in the sand that on a larger scale form a solar observatory in the Peruvian landscape. This short film explores the human fascination with observing the sun, and also reflects on the sense of sight. Eye Sun connects three sites of solar observation in Peru and three temporalities: Chankillo, considered the oldest solar observatory in the Americas; the Huancayo Observatory, active since 1922; and CIEASEST in Ica, where specific chemical elements present in the spectrum of sunlight are observed and analyzed.
items.title: Eye Sun

items.overview: Filmmaker Néstor López never got along well with his grandfather. He was an unpleasant man, difficult to read. He would have liked to become a singer or actor, but instead spent all 90 years of his life in the same quiet hamlet in rural Spain. Alongside his factory job, he devoted himself to making fishing flies by hand for catching trout and salmon.
items.title: Canina

items.overview: When someone ignores their friend, they get sent to a different world where no one exists.
items.title: The Other World

items.overview: After finding the “cure to loneliness”, Damien must choose his reality
items.title: Scission

items.overview: A mortal encounters a celestial being in the forest, whose magical flute controls the flow of time.
items.title: SYNCYTIUM

items.overview: Radhika lives in West Australia and is married to Kumar. Things are a bit rocky in their relationship when he forgets her birthday
items.title: Hate Marriage

items.overview: In Baja Verapaz, the Maya Poqomchi community of Renacimiento continues to resist the land dispossession that forced them from their territory in the 1990s. Today, a new generation is leading a collective struggle for justice, historical memory, and the restoration of their ancestral lands. The story of Renacimiento stands as a living testament to the resilience of Indigenous peoples and their tireless defense of land and life.
items.title: Renacimiento

items.original_title: La llegada al río de un apuesto piraguista
items.title: La llegada al río de un apuesto piraguista

items.overview: In the Sierra de las Navajas, in the state of Hidalgo, a craft connects Mexico’s past and present: working with obsidian.
items.title: Iztépetl: Glimmers of the Past

items.overview: A documentary recording of the second edition of Tocata Piolin—a day when, despite the rain forecast, music and friendship made it happen.
items.title: Tocata Piolin 2: Winter Edition

items.overview: A bangladeshi delivery rider and an urbanist tour guide drift through Porto witnessing how the city reorders itself in the era of digital globalization.
items.title: A Cidade e os Mapas

items.original_title: Andata Ritorno - Capitolo I: Senza fine
items.overview: Andata Ritorno is the first chapter of a movement in an almost diary-like form, which takes the director from illness back to the world. From the very first days of his hospital stay, Tonino films, as though capturing this suspended time might help him endure it. It is a long passage, populated by the people closest to him. There are his daughters, Giulia and Veronica, their children, his lifelong partner Mariella, and Alberto, who has stood by his side throughout his filmmaking journey. And then there are his geographies, stretching from Casalborgone to the wider world, bringing together the many people he has filmed there, in the microcosm of a room that opens up countless doors onto life and his films alike.
items.title: Andata Ritorno - Capitolo I: Senza fine

items.overview: In a world of digital immediacy and AI art, one filmmaker explores how a passionate community is turning back to the tangible beauty of film.
items.title: Analog

items.overview: A new student has just moved abroad. He starts meeting people on a dating app... until a funny surprise spices things up.
items.title: Yellow Fiction

items.overview: A teenager and a older man are dining in an elegant restaurant, the young one is clearly uncomfortable with the physical contact of the adult towards him, after a moment of introspection, decides to put a limit to escape the situation.
items.title: The Limit

items.overview: At Ana's quinceañera party, her chambelán, Mauricio, aims to confess his love after facing a series of obstacles that will make him second-guess his decision.
items.title: One Night

items.overview: Chad Chadley, a man who's wife died of super aids, and Norman Nerdyman, a virgin, are sent by The Boss to diffuse a bomb by playing Wordle to save the world.
items.title: SUPER BULLET

items.overview: A young man races against time to find and finish writing a book so he can hand it over to a higher entity and be judged.
items.title: While I Wait

items.overview: Luna wakes up disoriented in a workshop where a stranger harasses her while chopping meat. After attacking her, the kidnapper offers her a  way out: find the key to earn her freedom, forcing her to go to unimaginable lengths to survive.
items.title: Tender Flesh

items.overview: During a depressive period one night, a guy discovers a ghost in his room.
items.title: This is Why

items.overview: Somewhere else, two people, two separate lives. Moving through the same world, beneath the same sky, caught in the same quiet patterns. Their paths seem to mirror one another, as if written in parallel, always close, yet never close enough. Two stories unfolding side by side, in a universe where almost meeting is its own kind of loneliness. They exist in the same somewhere, but never in the same moment.
items.title: Somewhere Else

items.overview: To escape the scorching afternoon heat, five teenagers head to the river. We hear their voices as they talk in the shade of the mountain and the surrounding forest. They swim, sit on rocks and invent new games. Embraced by nature, the teenagers become part of it; they are almost one with the water, the earth, the little rocks lining the riverbed.
items.title: Sponde

items.overview: Follows the investigation of the mysterious "Mad Pooper" case, in which a female jogger repeatedly defecated on lawns in Colorado Springs, exploring archival coverage, resident accounts and law enforcement interviews to uncover the truth.
items.title: The Mad Pooper

items.overview: Every year, a group of Scottish teenagers who feel unseen - bullied, isolated, struggling to cope - are selected for something extraordinary: a year of brutal physical training culminating in a polar expedition. The expedition, whether Finland or Greenland's storms, is the culmination, not the point. What the film really tracks is one transformation happening in different registers at once: invisible kids learning how to be seen.
items.title: You Should See Me Now

items.overview: During a brief stop in the heart of a forest, Selvan, a Tamil migrant bound for England, finds himself stranded in France with no landmarks or resources. Left to wander an unfamiliar city whose language he does not speak, he drifts between hope and panic, facing silence, suspicion, and rare glimmers of humanity. Oru Nimidam (One Minute) captures, over a compressed timeline, the intimate downward spiral of an ordinary man whose life suddenly hangs in the balance revealing the invisible violence of borders and the vulnerability of those who cross them.
items.title: One Minute

items.overview: “Feel the fear and do it anyway” is the motto that 55-year-old Heli Murray teaches, and practices, as a birth doula and endurance athlete. Parallel to navigating motherhood, divorce, menopause and grandmotherhood, the ocean has been Heli’s sanctuary and outlet for expanding her own edges.
items.title: Too Old Not To

items.overview: Un equipo de documentalistas llega a una fábrica abandonada para investigar la polémica muerte de varias empleadas. Mientras la investigación avanza comienzan a registrar algo aterrador que no los dejará salir.  - A documentary crew arrives at an abandoned factory to investigate the controversial deaths of several female employees. As the investigation unfolds, they begin to capture something terrifying—something that will not let them leave. -
items.title: La Fábrica

items.overview: Inside mountain bike downhill phenom Jackson Goldstone's high-stakes bid to become one of the youngest riders in history to claim the UCI DH Elite overall title. From pre-season testing to the tense, pressure-filled moments leading into the last race of the year, the film follows Jackson and the team that supports him as they hunt for every possible edge in a sport where the smallest fractions of time can define a champion. With the title on the line and only one decisive run remaining, Jackson prepares to risk everything for the win.
items.title: The Search for Milliseconds

items.overview: Jazz drummer Michael Brewer takes Chicago by storm.
items.title: Michael Michael Michael

items.overview: one late night Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy and Catwoman bump into each other having similar motives to steal the "Belgian minature" they play a game of rock, paper, scissors to determine who gets to try and steal it first, Harley Quinn gets the honor.
items.title: The Boingy Boingy Film

items.overview: In the remote Accursed Mountains of Kosovo, former junior ski champions Seb and Hamda have built an off-grid freeride lodge in search of something they lost long ago. Through breathtaking mountain landscapes, snowboarding and deeply personal memories, the film traces their journey from childhood dreams, through the upheaval of war in the former Yugoslavia, to the creation of a place built on friendship, freedom and belonging.
items.title: Refuge

items.original_title: Todo lo que me pasa sucede en otro lugar
items.title: Todo lo que me pasa sucede en otro lugar

items.overview: Morgan McGlashon (professional mountain guide) and Caite Zeliff (professional skier) picked obscure paths. Those paths collided and became intertwined. When their careers took off they found themselves spending less time in the mountains together but they always dreamed of one day coming back together on a proper adventure. On a 10-day expedition in Alaska, the two reconnect.
items.title: My Ride or Die

items.original_title: Migrantes: el viaje que nadie quiso emprender
items.title: Migrantes: el viaje que nadie quiso emprender

items.original_title: More than Everest: The Life of T.H. Somervell
items.overview: T. Howard Somervell (1890-1975) is best known for his role in the 1922 and 1924 expeditions to climb Everest. This film explores the lesser known aspects of Somervell's remarkable life as a missionary surgeon, artist and composer of music.
items.title: More than Everest: The Life of T.H. Somervell

items.overview: Milakóta Yeló follows a traditional Lakota grandmother on the Cheyenne River Sioux Reservation. It's a quiet reflection on identity, memory, and the enduring presence of Lakota life and matriarchal power.
items.title: MiLakóta Yeló

items.overview: After years of exploring their world by bicycle, the Moss family knew that they wanted to raise their kids on two wheels. But after a frightening accident on the way to school, they had to take a step back from their pedal-powered ambitions. Then they found Kidical Mass. This is the story of how one family is helping to reclaim their streets, one giant kid bike party at a time.
items.title: Kidical Mass

items.overview: Longtime riding partners Sam and Jazz take a tandem bike across some of their favourite trails in the Rockies, marking ten years since their first tandem adventure together. Part celebration, part reflection, the film explores friendship, trust, and the rare joy of moving through the world in sync.
items.title: It Takes Two To Tandem

items.overview: In 1802, the Survey of India Institute launched the Great Trigonometrical Survey, a colossal undertaking aimed at precisely mapping British India from which the world became aware of the vast scale of the Himalayan range. From August to November 2024, using these historical maps, Jérémy Bigé makes his way on foot over 2,300km from Indian Kashmir to central Nepal. His goal: to connect the various Himalayan cultures in a single journey by following routes from the past.
items.title: The Himalayas in My Heart

items.overview: Over the holidays, Michael returns to the Midwest to stay with his best friends, all still living in their same old house from college in Milwaukee. During his several weeks stay, nights out are had, attempts are made to rekindle old flames, and it becomes more and more clear that his friends haven't grown up at all, while maybe Michael's grown up a little too much.
items.title: The Great Lake Bums

items.overview: The final chapter of KISSTORY. Go all-access backstage on the farewell tour, from the triumphs to the disasters, health scares and cancellations.
items.title: KISS: End of the Road

items.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.
items.title: Dark Noon

items.overview: Formline is the defining visual language of traditional Northwest Coast First Nations art; continuous, curvilinear shapes that swell, diminish, and never meet at a hard edge. This film traces the unexpected kinship between this ancient art form and the physics of big mountain snowboarding, where reading terrain and carving a line demand the same fluidity, restraint, and trust in the material at hand.
items.title: Formline

items.overview: In a world where it feels like we have everything we could ever want at our fingertips – Amazon, Spotify, next-day delivery, door-to-door, Uber, Netflix, Deliveroo, quicker than ever before, pure convenience and luxury without a second thought – in that world, perhaps there is something to be said for choosing the long way round. When Alice Lemkes realises she's out of milk, it is an excuse for an adventure in ‘Scotland's Last Great Wilderness.’
items.title: Back By Tea Time

items.overview: After a fatal car crash, four friends awaken trapped inside their wrecked car in a liminal space between life and death.
items.title: The Ride Home

items.overview: Two puppets meet on a blind date, and it's hate at first sight. But for their dutiful human puppeteers, the sparks fly instantly. What happens when a puppet and puppeteer disagree? A rowdy comedy about love, work, and obligation, in the age of social media.
items.title: No Strings Attached

items.overview: “Night of the Living Dead” but with squirrels! Four Gen Z neighbors are thrust into a squirrel apocalypse, so they hunker down in a bunker-like basement doing their best to survive, hoping there is refuge from the rodent rampage. One among them is an amateur survivalist “prepper”; emphasis on amateur.
items.title: The Squirrel Diaries

items.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.
items.title: Love in a Hopeless Place

items.overview: A reserved man discovers an alleyway garage concealing the ultimate mancave, and a charismatic host who won't take no for an answer.
items.title: Angler

items.overview: As Moira prepares for her anniversary dinner, her fond memories of true love put the romance back in necromancy.
items.title: Date Night

items.overview: A poetic exploration of the art of steep skiing with Aurélien Lardy. This film celebrates the art of the movement, the commitment, and the intimate relationship between the man and the mountain, and what draws us to vertical places.
items.title: À bord du vide

items.overview: The story revolves around an Italian mafia family that contacts the two sons of its late leader, who are living in Egypt, to inform them of their inheritance rights. However, two Egyptian men impersonate the heirs and travel to Italy, where they find themselves caught up in a series of unexpected situations and complications.
items.title: Crypto

items.overview: Offering unparalleled behind-the-scenes access to the 2025 F1 ACADEMY season, follow a group of elite female drivers, including Doriane Pin, Maya Weug, Chloe Chambers and Alisha Palmowski, as they navigate the pressures of competition and the personal sacrifices required to break into one of the most demanding sports in the world.
items.title: The Pursuit: F1 ACADEMY

items.overview: After a mountain bike crash resulted in a life altering injury, Chantelle Grafton and her husband Warren have gone to great lengths to get Chantelle back out on the trails. Still Rider explores this journey, highlighting the unanticipated complexities that come with a major spinal cord injury and more importantly the benefits of prioritising adaptive design for those with and without accessibility issues.
items.title: Still Rider

items.overview: This Sky Original documentary reconstructs an extraordinary true-crime case, focusing not on the perpetrator, but on the women—and their desperate attempts to break free from his violence. For the first time, Winfried’s first wife, Marja-Leena, and his daughter, Tuija, speak publicly about their experiences.
items.title: Mein Mann, mein Mörder

items.overview: While keeping a friend company on a night out, a young woman, grapples with the past, when faced with questions about her own identity.
items.title: A Little Closer

items.overview: I woke up at 5am with a giant rat lying on my chest.
items.title: Rat Story

items.overview: This film chronicles the journey of a sophisticated young schoolteacher whose city upbringing contrasts greatly with her new-found environment. Her reluctance to form relationships with other villagers takes a turn as she discovers a friendship in the place she never expected: with her students. With little time remaining during her placement at a village school, it is up to her to reveal the shocking discovery she has made. But will local folks believe this arrogant city woman?
items.title: Peretera Maneta

items.overview: A young man haunted by past trauma and hated by his father begins to experience disturbing whispers and horrifying visions in an old mansion. As he struggles to save his family, he becomes trapped between reality and his own imagination.
items.title: Bisikan

items.overview: Sol, a dancer and choreographer, is a pivotal figure in contemporary dance who, at 59, finds herself at a critical moment in her extraordinary career. With her crew, she's preparing "The Lamb and Her Army", an ambitious work that seems to mark the end of her career as a performer. With joints worn down after decades of physical demands, her doctor has surprising news…
items.title: Lamb

items.overview: What if leaving home simply wasn't an option? For 29-year-old Satomi, the answer seems absurdly literal. On the very morning she is finally ready to abandon her hometown for Tokyo, she discovers that every attempt to leave brings her straight back to where she started. Caught in an inexplicable time loop, Satomi has no choice but to confront the place and the people she was so determined to leave behind.
items.title: Jimoto Loop

items.overview: Following his father's death, Louis Hothothot turns the camera on his mother and sister in China. With fearless affection, he explores how misogyny has affected the lives of the women in his family across generations.
items.title: The Year of the Ghost

items.overview: Francisca reopens her family home in southern Chile, empty and frozen in time since the death of her parents. As she restores the place with her brother, the figure of her alcoholic father takes shape through their memories, Fran's diaries, and family photos, opening up an exploration of what silently persists between generations.
items.title: When the clouds move south

items.overview: The story of the historic Vasco da Gama team—composed primarily of Black players from humble backgrounds—which, in 1923, secured the club’s first-ever Campeonato Carioca title. Blending documentary and fiction, the film bridges over a century of history to examine the persistence of racism in both football and contemporary society.
items.title: Black Shirts

items.overview: At dawn, riders set off from Cork City on a self-supported journey of up to 2,400km, bound for the finish line across Derry’s Peace Bridge, battling fierce winds, rugged terrain, and shifting light. Narrated by veteran long-distance cyclist and event organiser Adrian O’Sullivan, the film immerses viewers in Ireland’s dark and mystical landscape, capturing the endurance, solitude, and raw beauty of the western coast.
items.title: The TransAtlantic Way

items.overview: When their nine-year-old daughter falls mysteriously ill, a wealthy Dominican couple turns to an experimental treatment created from their housemaid Liddy's feces, without her knowledge. Once Liddy and her colleague Dominga discover the truth, they seize the opportunity to turn the household’s power dynamics upside down.
items.title: Sh*t Happens

items.overview: When financial struggles threaten to close her family’s art-tour business before Christmas, self-taught artist Shelby Stevens enters a televised holiday painting competition, hoping the prize money can save it. During the competition, Shelby clashes with fellow contestant “Mark,” whose polished talent and charm slowly win her over through festive adventures and late-night creative breakthroughs. But when Shelby discovers Mark is actually Prince Henry of Serendovia, secretly escaping royal expectations to pursue art, their growing romance is put at risk. As Christmas approaches, Shelby and Henry must decide whether they are confident enough to paint a future of their own.
items.title: The Painter & the Prince

items.overview: Nature documentary
items.title: Voyage

items.overview: Mid drag performance at a queer bar in Cork, Claire is shocked to spot her traditional Catholic Nana in the crowd. A  conversation unfolds with them backstage, where they realise they both have a lot more in common than they ever could have imagined.
items.title: Show Pony

items.overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.
items.title: Menang Untuk Kalah

items.overview: A broken heart drives Mukidi to prove that he is worthy of marrying the woman of his dreams. He works hard until he is able to buy an inexpensive house, which turns out to hold a mystery. In that house, he meets Sukma, a mysterious woman from the spirit world who has a different religion and background, yet manages to help Mukidi get over his heartbreak. Strange events begin to unfold, dragging his two best friends, Gendut and Penyok, into the chaos.
items.title: Piye To Kih?

items.overview: It’s not the hit… it’s how you rise.
items.title: Fight Back

items.overview: A colourful town inhabited by animals prepares for a carnival parade.
items.title: Carnival of the Animals

items.overview: Julia inherited her mother Asunta’s job as a domestic worker in the wealthy De la Puente household, where she was raised alongside the family’s daughters. Asunta, an Andean woman who migrated to Lima after Peru’s 1970 earthquake, carried a life shaped by displacement, silence, and sacrifice. Over the years, affection and inequality became inseparably intertwined within the household. Now, as illness and old age expose long-buried secrets, Julia is forced to confront the invisible social order that has defined her existence. Torn between loyalty and freedom, she must decide whether to remain in the role imposed on her or finally reclaim her own identity.
items.title: The Girls Garden

items.overview: After a devastating flood, a mysterious parasitic outbreak engulfs a remote village. As Luna and her father, Damien, struggle to survive, they're forced to confront the brutality of nature and the darkest side of humanity. Filled with separation, loss, and horrifying truths, their journey changes their fate forever.
items.title: Obitus

items.overview: Renowned documentarian Thomas Heise begins a film on Berlin's Schönhauser Allee, the road he lived on for decades. A few months later, Heise dies unexpectedly.
items.title: Transition

items.overview: Emma is a young woman who discovers that the man who raised her is not her biological father. Her search for the truth becomes a transformative journey across Morocco; a quest for identity, freedom, family and self-discovery.
items.title: Il destino dell'ape

items.overview: With his shimmering scales, the Rainbow Fish is the most beautiful fish in the entire ocean. But he is also vain and proud, which alienates the other fish. As a result, he becomes increasingly lonely. When he eventually loses one of his beloved glittering scales, it is none other than the Little Blue fish who accompanies him on the search into the deepest parts of the ocean. An adventurous journey begins – and the Rainbow Fish learns that together we are much braver than alone, and that true friendship is more precious than the most magnificent coat of scales.
items.title: Break

results.overview: A behind the scenes look at director/ actress Louisa Connolly Burnham's short film "The Intimacy Coordinator".
results.title: Making The Intimacy Coordinator

results.title: Hate Marriage

Today, a new generation is leading a collective struggle for justice, historical memory, and the restoration of their ancestral lands. The story of Renacimiento stands as a living testament to the resilience of Indigenous peoples and their tireless defense of land and life.
results.title: Renacimiento

results.original_title: La llegada al río de un apuesto piraguista
results.title: La llegada al río de un apuesto piraguista

results.overview: In the Sierra de las Navajas, in the state of Hidalgo, a craft connects Mexico’s past and present: working with obsidian.
results.title: Iztépetl: Glimmers of the Past

results.overview: A documentary recording of the second edition of Tocata Piolin—a day when, despite the rain forecast, music and friendship made it happen.
results.title: Tocata Piolin 2: Winter Edition

results.overview: A bangladeshi delivery rider and an urbanist tour guide drift through Porto witnessing how the city reorders itself in the era of digital globalization.
results.title: A Cidade e os Mapas

results.original_title: Andata Ritorno - Capitolo I: Senza fine
results.overview: Andata Ritorno is the first chapter of a movement in an almost diary-like form, which takes the director from illness back to the world. From the very first days of his hospital stay, Tonino films, as though capturing this suspended time might help him endure it. It is a long passage, populated by the people closest to him. There are his daughters, Giulia and Veronica, their children, his lifelong partner Mariella, and Alberto, who has stood by his side throughout his filmmaking journey. And then there are his geographies, stretching from Casalborgone to the wider world, bringing together the many people he has filmed there, in the microcosm of a room that opens up countless doors onto life and his films alike.
results.title: Andata Ritorno - Capitolo I: Senza fine

results.overview: In a world of digital immediacy and AI art, one filmmaker explores how a passionate community is turning back to the tangible beauty of film.
results.title: Analog

results.overview: A new student has just moved abroad. He starts meeting people on a dating app... until a funny surprise spices things up.
results.title: Yellow Fiction

results.overview: A teenager and a older man are dining in an elegant restaurant, the young one is clearly uncomfortable with the physical contact of the adult towards him, after a moment of introspection, decides to put a limit to escape the situation.
results.title: The Limit

results.overview: At Ana's quinceañera party, her chambelán, Mauricio, aims to confess his love after facing a series of obstacles that will make him second-guess his decision.
results.title: One Night

results.overview: Chad Chadley, a man who's wife died of super aids, and Norman Nerdyman, a virgin, are sent by The Boss to diffuse a bomb by playing Wordle to save the world.
results.title: SUPER BULLET

results.overview: A young man races against time to find and finish writing a book so he can hand it over to a higher entity and be judged.
results.title: While I Wait

results.overview: Luna wakes up disoriented in a workshop where a stranger harasses her while chopping meat. After attacking her, the kidnapper offers her a  way out: find the key to earn her freedom, forcing her to go to unimaginable lengths to survive.
results.title: Tender Flesh

results.overview: During a depressive period one night, a guy discovers a ghost in his room.
results.title: This is Why

results.overview: Somewhere else, two people, two separate lives. Moving through the same world, beneath the same sky, caught in the same quiet patterns. Their paths seem to mirror one another, as if written in parallel, always close, yet never close enough. Two stories unfolding side by side, in a universe where almost meeting is its own kind of loneliness. They exist in the same somewhere, but never in the same moment.
results.title: Somewhere Else

results.overview: To escape the scorching afternoon heat, five teenagers head to the river. We hear their voices as they talk in the shade of the mountain and the surrounding forest. They swim, sit on rocks and invent new games. Embraced by nature, the teenagers become part of it; they are almost one with the water, the earth, the little rocks lining the riverbed.
results.title: Sponde

results.overview: Follows the investigation of the mysterious "Mad Pooper" case, in which a female jogger repeatedly defecated on lawns in Colorado Springs, exploring archival coverage, resident accounts and law enforcement interviews to uncover the truth.
results.title: The Mad Pooper

results.overview: Every year, a group of Scottish teenagers who feel unseen - bullied, isolated, struggling to cope - are selected for something extraordinary: a year of brutal physical training culminating in a polar expedition. The expedition, whether Finland or Greenland's storms, is the culmination, not the point. What the film really tracks is one transformation happening in different registers at once: invisible kids learning how to be seen.
results.title: You Should See Me Now

results.overview: During a brief stop in the heart of a forest, Selvan, a Tamil migrant bound for England, finds himself stranded in France with no landmarks or resources. Left to wander an unfamiliar city whose language he does not speak, he drifts between hope and panic, facing silence, suspicion, and rare glimmers of humanity. Oru Nimidam (One Minute) captures, over a compressed timeline, the intimate downward spiral of an ordinary man whose life suddenly hangs in the balance revealing the invisible violence of borders and the vulnerability of those who cross them.
results.title: One Minute

results.overview: “Feel the fear and do it anyway” is the motto that 55-year-old Heli Murray teaches, and practices, as a birth doula and endurance athlete. Parallel to navigating motherhood, divorce, menopause and grandmotherhood, the ocean has been Heli’s sanctuary and outlet for expanding her own edges.
results.title: Too Old Not To

results.overview: Un equipo de documentalistas llega a una fábrica abandonada para investigar la polémica muerte de varias empleadas. Mientras la investigación avanza comienzan a registrar algo aterrador que no los dejará salir.  - A documentary crew arrives at an abandoned factory to investigate the controversial deaths of several female employees. As the investigation unfolds, they begin to capture something terrifying—something that will not let them leave. -
results.title: La Fábrica

results.overview: Inside mountain bike downhill phenom Jackson Goldstone's high-stakes bid to become one of the youngest riders in history to claim the UCI DH Elite overall title. From pre-season testing to the tense, pressure-filled moments leading into the last race of the year, the film follows Jackson and the team that supports him as they hunt for every possible edge in a sport where the smallest fractions of time can define a champion. With the title on the line and only one decisive run remaining, Jackson prepares to risk everything for the win.
results.title: The Search for Milliseconds

results.overview: Jazz drummer Michael Brewer takes Chicago by storm.
results.title: Michael Michael Michael

results.overview: one late night Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy and Catwoman bump into each other having similar motives to steal the "Belgian minature" they play a game of rock, paper, scissors to determine who gets to try and steal it first, Harley Quinn gets the honor.
results.title: The Boingy Boingy Film

results.overview: In the remote Accursed Mountains of Kosovo, former junior ski champions Seb and Hamda have built an off-grid freeride lodge in search of something they lost long ago. Through breathtaking mountain landscapes, snowboarding and deeply personal memories, the film traces their journey from childhood dreams, through the upheaval of war in the former Yugoslavia, to the creation of a place built on friendship, freedom and belonging.
results.title: Refuge

results.original_title: Todo lo que me pasa sucede en otro lugar
results.title: Todo lo que me pasa sucede en otro lugar

results.overview: Morgan McGlashon (professional mountain guide) and Caite Zeliff (professional skier) picked obscure paths. Those paths collided and became intertwined. When their careers took off they found themselves spending less time in the mountains together but they always dreamed of one day coming back together on a proper adventure. On a 10-day expedition in Alaska, the two reconnect.
results.title: My Ride or Die

results.original_title: Migrantes: el viaje que nadie quiso emprender
results.title: Migrantes: el viaje que nadie quiso emprender

results.original_title: More than Everest: The Life of T.H. Somervell
results.overview: T. Howard Somervell (1890-1975) is best known for his role in the 1922 and 1924 expeditions to climb Everest. This film explores the lesser known aspects of Somervell's remarkable life as a missionary surgeon, artist and composer of music.
results.title: More than Everest: The Life of T.H. Somervell

results.overview: Milakóta Yeló follows a traditional Lakota grandmother on the Cheyenne River Sioux Reservation. It's a quiet reflection on identity, memory, and the enduring presence of Lakota life and matriarchal power.
results.title: MiLakóta Yeló

results.overview: After years of exploring their world by bicycle, the Moss family knew that they wanted to raise their kids on two wheels. But after a frightening accident on the way to school, they had to take a step back from their pedal-powered ambitions. Then they found Kidical Mass. This is the story of how one family is helping to reclaim their streets, one giant kid bike party at a time.
results.title: Kidical Mass

results.overview: Longtime riding partners Sam and Jazz take a tandem bike across some of their favourite trails in the Rockies, marking ten years since their first tandem adventure together. Part celebration, part reflection, the film explores friendship, trust, and the rare joy of moving through the world in sync.
results.title: It Takes Two To Tandem

results.overview: In 1802, the Survey of India Institute launched the Great Trigonometrical Survey, a colossal undertaking aimed at precisely mapping British India from which the world became aware of the vast scale of the Himalayan range. From August to November 2024, using these historical maps, Jérémy Bigé makes his way on foot over 2,300km from Indian Kashmir to central Nepal. His goal: to connect the various Himalayan cultures in a single journey by following routes from the past.
results.title: The Himalayas in My Heart

results.overview: Over the holidays, Michael returns to the Midwest to stay with his best friends, all still living in their same old house from college in Milwaukee. During his several weeks stay, nights out are had, attempts are made to rekindle old flames, and it becomes more and more clear that his friends haven't grown up at all, while maybe Michael's grown up a little too much.
results.title: The Great Lake Bums

results.overview: The final chapter of KISSTORY. Go all-access backstage on the farewell tour, from the triumphs to the disasters, health scares and cancellations.
results.title: KISS: End of the Road

results.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.
results.title: Dark Noon

results.overview: Formline is the defining visual language of traditional Northwest Coast First Nations art; continuous, curvilinear shapes that swell, diminish, and never meet at a hard edge. This film traces the unexpected kinship between this ancient art form and the physics of big mountain snowboarding, where reading terrain and carving a line demand the same fluidity, restraint, and trust in the material at hand.
results.title: Formline

results.overview: In a world where it feels like we have everything we could ever want at our fingertips – Amazon, Spotify, next-day delivery, door-to-door, Uber, Netflix, Deliveroo, quicker than ever before, pure convenience and luxury without a second thought – in that world, perhaps there is something to be said for choosing the long way round. When Alice Lemkes realises she's out of milk, it is an excuse for an adventure in ‘Scotland's Last Great Wilderness.’
results.title: Back By Tea Time

results.overview: After a fatal car crash, four friends awaken trapped inside their wrecked car in a liminal space between life and death.
results.title: The Ride Home

results.overview: Two puppets meet on a blind date, and it's hate at first sight. But for their dutiful human puppeteers, the sparks fly instantly. What happens when a puppet and puppeteer disagree? A rowdy comedy about love, work, and obligation, in the age of social media.
results.title: No Strings Attached

results.overview: “Night of the Living Dead” but with squirrels! Four Gen Z neighbors are thrust into a squirrel apocalypse, so they hunker down in a bunker-like basement doing their best to survive, hoping there is refuge from the rodent rampage. One among them is an amateur survivalist “prepper”; emphasis on amateur.
results.title: The Squirrel Diaries

results.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.
results.title: Love in a Hopeless Place

results.overview: A reserved man discovers an alleyway garage concealing the ultimate mancave, and a charismatic host who won't take no for an answer.
results.title: Angler

results.overview: As Moira prepares for her anniversary dinner, her fond memories of true love put the romance back in necromancy.
results.title: Date Night

results.overview: A poetic exploration of the art of steep skiing with Aurélien Lardy. This film celebrates the art of the movement, the commitment, and the intimate relationship between the man and the mountain, and what draws us to vertical places.
results.title: À bord du vide

results.overview: The story revolves around an Italian mafia family that contacts the two sons of its late leader, who are living in Egypt, to inform them of their inheritance rights. However, two Egyptian men impersonate the heirs and travel to Italy, where they find themselves caught up in a series of unexpected situations and complications.
results.title: Crypto

results.overview: Offering unparalleled behind-the-scenes access to the 2025 F1 ACADEMY season, follow a group of elite female drivers, including Doriane Pin, Maya Weug, Chloe Chambers and Alisha Palmowski, as they navigate the pressures of competition and the personal sacrifices required to break into one of the most demanding sports in the world.
results.title: The Pursuit: F1 ACADEMY

results.overview: After a mountain bike crash resulted in a life altering injury, Chantelle Grafton and her husband Warren have gone to great lengths to get Chantelle back out on the trails. Still Rider explores this journey, highlighting the unanticipated complexities that come with a major spinal cord injury and more importantly the benefits of prioritising adaptive design for those with and without accessibility issues.
results.title: Still Rider

results.overview: This Sky Original documentary reconstructs an extraordinary true-crime case, focusing not on the perpetrator, but on the women—and their desperate attempts to break free from his violence. For the first time, Winfried’s first wife, Marja-Leena, and his daughter, Tuija, speak publicly about their experiences.
results.title: Mein Mann, mein Mörder

results.overview: While keeping a friend company on a night out, a young woman, grapples with the past, when faced with questions about her own identity.
results.title: A Little Closer

results.overview: I woke up at 5am with a giant rat lying on my chest.
results.title: Rat Story

results.overview: This film chronicles the journey of a sophisticated young schoolteacher whose city upbringing contrasts greatly with her new-found environment. Her reluctance to form relationships with other villagers takes a turn as she discovers a friendship in the place she never expected: with her students. With little time remaining during her placement at a village school, it is up to her to reveal the shocking discovery she has made. But will local folks believe this arrogant city woman?
results.title: Peretera Maneta

results.overview: A young man haunted by past trauma and hated by his father begins to experience disturbing whispers and horrifying visions in an old mansion. As he struggles to save his family, he becomes trapped between reality and his own imagination.
results.title: Bisikan

results.overview: Sol, a dancer and choreographer, is a pivotal figure in contemporary dance who, at 59, finds herself at a critical moment in her extraordinary career. With her crew, she's preparing "The Lamb and Her Army", an ambitious work that seems to mark the end of her career as a performer. With joints worn down after decades of physical demands, her doctor has surprising news…
results.title: Lamb

results.overview: What if leaving home simply wasn't an option? For 29-year-old Satomi, the answer seems absurdly literal. On the very morning she is finally ready to abandon her hometown for Tokyo, she discovers that every attempt to leave brings her straight back to where she started. Caught in an inexplicable time loop, Satomi has no choice but to confront the place and the people she was so determined to leave behind.
results.title: Jimoto Loop

results.overview: Following his father's death, Louis Hothothot turns the camera on his mother and sister in China. With fearless affection, he explores how misogyny has affected the lives of the women in his family across generations.
results.title: The Year of the Ghost

results.overview: Francisca reopens her family home in southern Chile, empty and frozen in time since the death of her parents. As she restores the place with her brother, the figure of her alcoholic father takes shape through their memories, Fran's diaries, and family photos, opening up an exploration of what silently persists between generations.
results.title: When the clouds move south

results.overview: The story of the historic Vasco da Gama team—composed primarily of Black players from humble backgrounds—which, in 1923, secured the club’s first-ever Campeonato Carioca title. Blending documentary and fiction, the film bridges over a century of history to examine the persistence of racism in both football and contemporary society.
results.title: Black Shirts

results.overview: At dawn, riders set off from Cork City on a self-supported journey of up to 2,400km, bound for the finish line across Derry’s Peace Bridge, battling fierce winds, rugged terrain, and shifting light. Narrated by veteran long-distance cyclist and event organiser Adrian O’Sullivan, the film immerses viewers in Ireland’s dark and mystical landscape, capturing the endurance, solitude, and raw beauty of the western coast.
results.title: The TransAtlantic Way

results.overview: When their nine-year-old daughter falls mysteriously ill, a wealthy Dominican couple turns to an experimental treatment created from their housemaid Liddy's feces, without her knowledge. Once Liddy and her colleague Dominga discover the truth, they seize the opportunity to turn the household’s power dynamics upside down.
results.title: Sh*t Happens

results.overview: When financial struggles threaten to close her family’s art-tour business before Christmas, self-taught artist Shelby Stevens enters a televised holiday painting competition, hoping the prize money can save it. During the competition, Shelby clashes with fellow contestant “Mark,” whose polished talent and charm slowly win her over through festive adventures and late-night creative breakthroughs. But when Shelby discovers Mark is actually Prince Henry of Serendovia, secretly escaping royal expectations to pursue art, their growing romance is put at risk. As Christmas approaches, Shelby and Henry must decide whether they are confident enough to paint a future of their own.
results.title: The Painter & the Prince

results.overview: Nature documentary
results.title: Voyage

results.overview: Mid drag performance at a queer bar in Cork, Claire is shocked to spot her traditional Catholic Nana in the crowd. A  conversation unfolds with them backstage, where they realise they both have a lot more in common than they ever could have imagined.
results.title: Show Pony

results.overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.
results.title: Menang Untuk Kalah

results.overview: A broken heart drives Mukidi to prove that he is worthy of marrying the woman of his dreams. He works hard until he is able to buy an inexpensive house, which turns out to hold a mystery. In that house, he meets Sukma, a mysterious woman from the spirit world who has a different religion and background, yet manages to help Mukidi get over his heartbreak. Strange events begin to unfold, dragging his two best friends, Gendut and Penyok, into the chaos.
results.title: Piye To Kih?

results.overview: It’s not the hit… it’s how you rise.
results.title: Fight Back

results.overview: A colourful town inhabited by animals prepares for a carnival parade.
results.title: Carnival of the Animals

results.overview: Julia inherited her mother Asunta’s job as a domestic worker in the wealthy De la Puente household, where she was raised alongside the family’s daughters. Asunta, an Andean woman who migrated to Lima after Peru’s 1970 earthquake, carried a life shaped by displacement, silence, and sacrifice. Over the years, affection and inequality became inseparably intertwined within the household. Now, as illness and old age expose long-buried secrets, Julia is forced to confront the invisible social order that has defined her existence. Torn between loyalty and freedom, she must decide whether to remain in the role imposed on her or finally reclaim her own identity.
results.title: The Girls Garden

results.overview: After a devastating flood, a mysterious parasitic outbreak engulfs a remote village. As Luna and her father, Damien, struggle to survive, they're forced to confront the brutality of nature and the darkest side of humanity. Filled with separation, loss, and horrifying truths, their journey changes their fate forever.
results.title: Obitus

results.overview: Renowned documentarian Thomas Heise begins a film on Berlin's Schönhauser Allee, the road he lived on for decades. A few months later, Heise dies unexpectedly.
results.title: Transition

results.overview: Emma is a young woman who discovers that the man who raised her is not her biological father. Her search for the truth becomes a transformative journey across Morocco; a quest for identity, freedom, family and self-discovery.
results.title: Il destino dell'ape

results.overview: With his shimmering scales, the Rainbow Fish is the most beautiful fish in the entire ocean. But he is also vain and proud, which alienates the other fish. As a result, he becomes increasingly lonely. When he eventually loses one of his beloved glittering scales, it is none other than the Little Blue fish who accompanies him on the search into the deepest parts of the ocean. An adventurous journey begins – and the Rainbow Fish learns that together we are much braver than alone, and that true friendship is more precious than the most magnificent coat of scales.
results.title: Break
